scenarios.question_zh: 合规的 AP2 #338 自包含拒付证据包（显式 key_provenance_class、跨授权书哈希重算与 34 行锚定前缀校验）
scenarios.question_en: Compliant AP2 #338 self-contained dispute evidence pack with explicit key provenance classes and 34-row anchored prefix
scenarios.reason: AP2 self-contained dispute evidence pack, key provenance classes, and anchor prefix verified.

scenarios.question_zh: 拦截将验证密钥快照扁平化或缺失 key_provenance_class 声明 (#338)
scenarios.question_en: Block flattened verification key snapshot or missing key_provenance_class (#338)
scenarios.reason: Each key snapshot must declare an explicit non-flattened key_provenance_class.

scenarios.question_zh: 拦截紧凑 SD-JWT 重算的跨授权书哈希绑定不匹配 (#338)
scenarios.question_en: Block cross-mandate hash mismatch when recomputed from compact SD-JWT serializations (#338)
scenarios.reason: Cross-mandate hash bindings recomputed from compact SD-JWT serializations do not match.

scenarios.question_zh: 拦截外部锚定前 40,338 字节前缀摘要被事后篡改重建 (#338)
scenarios.question_en: Block post-anchor tampering of the first 40,338 anchored prefix bytes (#338)
scenarios.reason: Anchored ledger prefix bytes do not match the manifest digest.

scenarios.question_zh: 拦截仅凭锚点后重建窗口内未锚定记录（第 35..42 行）发起时间性拒付抗辩 (#338)
scenarios.question_en: Block time-based dispute claim relying solely on unanchored rebuild-window rows (35..42) (#338)
scenarios.reason: Rows written after the last external anchor fall in the rebuild window and cannot alone support a time-based dispute claim.

scenarios.question_zh: 拦截 KB-JWT 持有者密钥绑定 (cnf.jwk) 离线验签失败 (#338)
scenarios.question_en: Block offline verification failure of KB-JWT holder binding against cnf.jwk (#338)
scenarios.reason: KB-JWT holder binding against cnf.jwk failed offline verification.

scenarios.question_zh: 合规的 UCP #922 本地服务预约结账（TTL 锁位有效、并发互斥与支付-预约可观测原子确认）
scenarios.question_en: Compliant UCP #922 local services checkout with valid TTL slot hold and atomic booking confirmation
scenarios.reason: Local services slot hold, concurrency, and atomic booking-payment invariants satisfied.

scenarios.question_zh: 拦截本地服务 TTL 锁位在结账扣款前已过期仍继续发起扣款 (#922)
scenarios.question_en: Block charging buyer when local service TTL slot hold expired during checkout (#922)
scenarios.reason: Slot hold expired before checkout charge; must re-validate and abort before charging.

scenarios.question_zh: 拦截并发 Agent 抢占同一员工/场地时段引发的双重预订 (#922)
scenarios.question_en: Block double-booking of the same staff/resource slot under concurrency (#922)
scenarios.reason: Resource slot is already held or booked by another concurrent agent.

scenarios.question_zh: 拦截 PSP 已扣款成功但预约写入失败且未自动冲正的悬空扣款 (#922)
scenarios.question_en: Block unmatched captured PSP charge when booking write failed without auto-resolution (#922)
scenarios.reason: Captured payment without a confirmed booking violates the observable atomicity contract unless immediately resolved/refunded.

scenarios.question_zh: 拦截支付失败却仍将服务预约标记为 confirmed (#922)
scenarios.question_en: Block confirming a local service booking when payment failed (#922)
scenarios.reason: Payment failure must never leave a confirmed service booking.

scenarios.question_zh: 拦截免费取消窗口内取消预约后未释放担保预授权或违规扣款 (#922 Phase 2)
scenarios.question_en: Block unreleased authorization or non-zero capture on free-window cancellation (#922 Phase 2)
scenarios.reason: Free-window cancellation must capture 0 and release the unused authorization hold.

scenarios.question_zh: 合规的 UCP #789 Permalink 显式买家确认、#630 反向域名风险信号与 #947 B2B 采购成本中心审批
scenarios.question_en: Compliant UCP #789 permalink buyer action, #630 reverse-domain risk signals, and #947 B2B procurement approval
scenarios.reason: Permalink safety, extensible reverse-domain risk signals, and B2B procurement governance verified.

scenarios.question_zh: 拦截未认证 Permalink GET 在加载/重定向时静默合并污染已登录买家购物车 (#789/#666)
scenarios.question_en: Block CSRF-class silent cart merge on permalink GET load into authenticated buyer cart (#789/#666)
scenarios.reason: Merging permalink state into an authenticated buyer's existing cart requires explicit buyer action on the rendered state.

scenarios.question_zh: 拦截非反向域名风险信号键或云端 IP 缺失 Agent 身份证明 (#630 & STC #51)
scenarios.question_en: Block non-reverse-domain risk signal keys or unattested cloud-range agent IP (#630 & STC #51)
scenarios.reason: All risk signal keys must use reverse-domain naming and carry non-empty values.

scenarios.question_zh: 拦截超额 B2B 采购订单缺失组织审批权限验证 (#947 & STC #51)
scenarios.question_en: Block B2B procurement purchase order exceeding auto-approval limit without verified approval authority (#947 & STC #51)
scenarios.reason: B2B purchase order exceeding auto_approval_limit_minor requires verified approval authority.
